name: demand-letter
description: Drafts U.S. pre-suit demand letters that work as settlement instruments and as defensible future exhibits: notices of breach and demands for cure, payment demands, cease and desist demands, statutory pre-suit notices (Massachusetts Chapter 93A, Texas DTPA 60-day notice, California CLRA 1782, Florida Chapter 558 and medical-malpractice notice of intent, defamation retraction demands, Magnuson-Moss opportunity to cure) and FDCPA collection demands. Builds an element-driven fact narrative with a source for every assertion, verifies or flags each authority, quantifies damages with methodology (multipliers, interest, mitigation, fees), computes each deadline from its own trigger, and applies ethics guardrails (represented parties, no criminal-threat leverage, FRE 408). Use for demand letter, pre-suit demand, settlement demand, 93A letter, DTPA notice, notice of intent, or pre-litigation correspondence. Routes any offer to settle within policy limits to bad-faith-demand and coverage questions to coverage-opinion.
